spec.evidence: LineageOS install guide for a52sxq writes every image through Download mode with samloader (Odin protocol); no fastboot step exists. HakiOS starts from `fastboot boot`, which this bootloader does not speak.
spec.notes: Same SoC as the HakiOS redwood reference port, so the SoC layer is reusable; the phone layer (panel, touch, PMIC rails, UEFI) is not.

notes: a52sxq uses the samsung-download bootloader: read-only device probing was skipped

capability.reason: Samsung Galaxy A52s 5G (a52sxq) has no fastboot protocol: its bootloader is samsung-download. `fastboot boot` cannot be used, and this tool will not substitute flashing or Odin.

message: Samsung Galaxy A52s 5G (a52sxq) has no fastboot protocol: its bootloader is samsung-download. `fastboot boot` cannot be used, and this tool will not substitute flashing or Odin.
detail:
LineageOS install guide for a52sxq writes every image through Download mode with samloader (Odin protocol); no fastboot step exists. HakiOS starts from `fastboot boot`, which this bootloader does not speak.

This tool will not substitute flashing or Odin.
